text: Baron Kazum is a mountain giant boss summoned at a Greater Windstone in Silithus. Summoning him requires a full Twilight Trappings set, a Twilight Cultist Medallion of Station, and a Twilight Cultist Ring of Lordship.

Ashamane was a ferocious Wild God in the form of a massive gray panther. She was one of many Wild Gods to fight in the War of the Ancients and defend the world of Azeroth from the Burning Legion, but she fell in battle against the pit lord Ronokon. A great shrine was built in the forests of Val'sharah to commemorate her sacrifice, and her massive fangs — all that remained of her after her violent death — were put on display there.
Arathi Giants are mountain giants located on the hills overlooking Arathi Basin. Some of them are engaged in combat with Arathi Ragers.

The Vo'lag (also known as Fomorians, Jotunn or Tugarin) are an ancient race of giants in the service of the Wyrm that dwelled in the northern hemisphere. The Get of Fenris, the Fianna, and the Wendigo battled them and drove them into the polar regions. They went into the Umbra in exile, cursing their enemies and waiting for the Apocalypse to get their revenge on their hated enemies.

Tsul'kalu is a spirit giant. The giant known as Tsul'kalu, or Judaculla, lived on the slope of a mountain near the Tuckaseegee River where it flows through the Nantahala National Forest near the meeting point of Swain, Jackson and Haywood Counties. Known by the Cherokee as the lord of the game, this massive visitor from the spirit world was often invoked in hunting ceremonies.

Jo'clatth'mattric, the dragon of Croatia, was a powerful Wyrm beast. It threatened all the surrounding lands until it was destroyed thanks to the heroic sacrifice of the pure breed Arkady Iceclaw, from House Crescent Moon of the Silver Fangs and by having its heart pierced by John North Wind's Son's Ice Spear.
Hydratron is a giant robot jellyfish created by the Quintessons. It's alternate mode is a city.

Godzilla (ゴジラ Gojira) is a mysterious creature similar to King Kong. He is big, green black most of the time, snorts fire, and is lizard-like. Mechagodzilla exists as a robotic duplicate. {| class="fandom-table" |
Raszagal was the Matriarch of the Dark Templar until the Brood War. She was one of the most powerful psychics in the galaxy. She was renowned for her stoicism and calmness.
Implosion is a psionic power used by Sarah Kerrigan during the Second Great War. She could crush vehicles as large as battlecruisers with it.

Creep teleport is an psionic power demonstrated by Sarah Kerrigan after she ascended into a xel'naga. Kerrigan is able to psionically teleport her and all zerg allies surrounding her to another spot that has been infested by creep.
Glutbunny, also known as the Ear God, was a giant rabbit that lived in the Land of Gods and was revered by its residents. It was killed by Luffy and eaten by the Straw Hat Pirates' Monster Trio.

Dragon Number Thirteen was a dragon created by Vegapunk to guard Punk Hazard. He carried out this duty even after Vegapunk and the World Government's departure until he was killed by Roronoa Zoro four years later. He was named by one of the World Nobles.

Hashirama slams the ground with his fist, releasing large trees from which rise from underground and capture the opponent, allowing him to finish them off by punching them down through the trees, and into the ground.
Hashirama enhances the physical strength of Wood Release: Wood Human Technique, which jumps and smashes the opponent with its fist, dealing great damage.

is a combined nature transformation kekkei genkai that can be used to move with incredible speed, becoming nothing more than a blur when in motion. Therefore, taijutsu becomes ineffective if the opponent is not fast enough.

After bathing in Ama no Hoko, the Nine-Tailed Naruto Clone's abilities were magnified and it could fire powerful purplish-orange chakra beams from its dragon/snake-like heads. These beams were powerful enough to cut through solid rock and even damage Naruto despite the latter being almost completely transformed into Kurama.

After opening the Eight Gates, Guy attacks the opponent with a very powerful downwards kick. Guy used this attack against the Demonic Statue of the Outer Path to literally attack its little toe, the force of which helped topple the statue over.
Suien can create a maze by blowing up a mountain and hammering stakes into the ground, with each carrying a special technique. pt-br:Barreira Labiríntica

After using Transformation: Adamantine Staff, Enma clones himself to create a lattice box around a target. Because of the toughness of Enma's adamantine form, opponents cannot break through the box once it's formed. When this box is formed around allies, this effectively protects them from harm. When it is formed around opponents, this effectively imprisons them until Enma chooses to release them.
The Lord of Dust, also known as the "King of the Monsters", was a giant crystalline life form that the Captain and his team of castaways encountered during the event on Dite.

The Destroyer is a Marvel Comics character, who appears in the Marvel Cinematic Universe in the movie Thor. He later was transformed into the Destroyer Armor Prototype Gun, used by Phil Coulson in The Avengers and Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.. The Destroyer is a Asgardian machine with unstoppable power. The Destroyer was created by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby.
Deforestator, also known as Experiment 515, is an illegal genetic experiment created by Jumba Jookiba and a character in the Lilo & Stitch franchise. He is designed to level entire forests.

The Dark Dragon is an extremely powerful and evil dragon and the overarching antagonist of American Dragon: Jake Long. He is considered the number one threat to the magical community and an enemy of non-magical people. He is the archenemy of Luong Lao Shi. He replaced the Huntsman as the primary villain for the last episodes of Season 2 in the series.
Storm (real name Ororo Munroe) is a mutant with the ability to control the weather and the field leader of the X-Men. Storm was created by Len Wein and Dave Cockrum.

An Yu is a character who has made her debut appearance in the third season of PJ Masks. She is the protector and guardian of Mystery Mountain, and revealed to be the human form of the Dragon from "The Dragon Gong". At some point in the past, she was trapped inside an ancient gong in her dragon form, forced to obey whoever possessed the gong's mallet. She was able to escape however when Night Ninja returned the gong to Mystery Mountain.
Abomination (real name Emil Blonsky) is a soldier-turned-monstrosity by gamma radiation, and is the evil counterpart of Hulk. The Abomination was created by Stan Lee and Gil Kane.

Tevesh Szat, the Doom of Fools, born Tev Loneglade, was a human planeswalker from Dominaria with a draconic form and one of the Nine Titans, a group of nine planeswalkers led by Urza in the defense of Dominaria. Although initially of a neutral disposition and refusing to become involved in others' matters, Szat's transformation to an evil character followed the death of his sister, prompting him to neutralize the world into silence. He would become a recurring evil force within Dominarian history and would plunge its continents and even the entire plane into chaos, culminating in his betrayal of the Nine Titans and his death at Urza's hands.

The Meteor Hammer spell was used by Tetsuo Umezawa to destroy the Imperial Shrine and thus rob Nicol Bolas of the mana base he needed to manifest in Dominaria. Tetsuo was taught this spell by Kolo Meha. The spell made the warhammer of Jorgan Hage fly into the sky until it reached the edge of the atmosphere, from where it plummeted like a meteor on Tetsuo's command. The spell was instrumental in the destruction of Nicol Bolas and the liberation of the Madaran Empire from his tyrannical rule.
Jareth, Leonine Titan, is a humanoid Cat Giant who was active in the Pre-Mending era of Dominara as a pit-fighter.
Heptane was a red dragon, one of the five dragon chiefs and a slave lord, who shared the rule of the Obsidian Well with Varuna, Macumba, Pizoondertanx, and Siliq.

The Gitrog monster is an enormous frog that lives in the depths of Lake Zhava, which is located in the highlands of Nephalia on Innistrad, near the border with Gavony. With the arrival of Emrakul, the monster was severely mutated by the Eldrazi titan's influence, losing any resemblance to a creature of the natural world. However, by the time of March of the Machine, it appears to have lost the mutations inflicted upon it by Emrakul.
Eron the Relentless is the immortal Goblin King of the Koskun Mountains of Ulgrotha.

is the Stand of Dos Santos, featured in the light novel El Aleph. It can manipulate to grow abnormally quickly, destroying its surroundings and then creating an entire man-eating forest in seconds around Dos Santos.

SMASH is an option in Completing the Mission during the "Jewel Baron" pathway. Henry Stickmin can use it to try and get the Norwegian Emerald out of the vault in the Toppat Orbital Station. Henry screams as he builds up his strength to smash into the vault to get the Emerald, but ends up making the entire orbital station explode due to his strength, which results in a fail.

Jugan, the Rising Star (JOO-gahn; ), was the great ryuu (divine dragon) of Kamigawa's forests. In particular, he was primarily the guardian of Jukai Forest and has since been reincarnated as Kura, who is female.
Jareth, Leonine Titan, is a humanoid Cat Giant who was active in the Pre-Mending era of Dominara as a pit-fighter.
Goddric is a Dragon from Eldraine who disguised himself as a Human Noble man.

The Gitrog monster is an enormous frog that lives in the depths of Lake Zhava, which is located in the highlands of Nephalia on Innistrad, near the border with Gavony. With the arrival of Emrakul, the monster was severely mutated by the Eldrazi titan's influence, losing any resemblance to a creature of the natural world. However, by the time of March of the Machine, it appears to have lost the mutations inflicted upon it by Emrakul.
Eron the Relentless is the immortal Goblin King of the Koskun Mountains of Ulgrotha.
Nagi is a Divine Dragon manakete that appears in Fire Emblem: Shadow Dragon and Fire Emblem: New Mystery of the Emblem. In Shadow Dragon, she is introduced as a special replacement character.
Dragons are powerful winged creatures that live on the continent of Argonnessen and are one of the oldest and most powerful civilizations on Eberron.

The Divided God is one of the names given to Leto Atreides II by the Rakian Priesthood. The term was used to describe both the Rakian sandworms and Leto himself. Upon his death, Leto's worm body disintegrated, thereby releasing hundreds of sandtrout into the desert, which would eventually lead to the re-emergence of sandworms on Rakis. Moreover, Leto had foreseen that upon his death, the worms that grew from the sandtrout would maintain a pearl of his consciousness, and that he would live on in an "endless dream" within the worms. Thus, the term "Divided God" would refer to the division of Leto through the sandworms.

Brutiks, Lightbane is a giant Scorn Ravager who appears within the Temple of the Wrathful, and is the final boss of The Ghosts Mission. It is shown to be powerful enough to rival the strength of Reksis Vahn, the Hangman, so much so that the Ghost even questions whether or not it might be a new Baron.

Morgeth, the Spirekeeper is an enormous, powerful Taken Ogre which serves as the enforcer of Riven's corruption in the Dreaming City, and the guard of the City's main tower, the Keep of Voices. He is the third boss of the Last Wish Raid.

Captain Marvel, also known as Shazam, is a character in the DC Universe who's been around since the Golden Age. Originally conceived as Fawcett Comics' answer to Superman, he is now owned by DC Comics and the character's mythos has grown strongly in its own right. Billy Batson is a young man who is given incredible powers by the wizard Shazam and only has to speak the name to transform into his alter ego Captain Marvel. Later on this position would go to his successor Freddy Freeman. Most of his comics are named after some variation on "Shazam" because of legal issues with Marvel Comics.
Snagglefang is a young green dragon from the Ashen Gorge, in Tal'Dorei.

Sha'korzhan, also known as the First Dragon of Avalir, was a true dragon who used to have his hoard on the top of Mount Ygora, which would become the floating city of Avalir. As a NPC, Sha'korzhan was played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

A lich is a powerful being who has been preserved as an undead through a powerful ritual that trapped its soul in a vessel called a phylactery. A dragon who undergoes this ritual is called a dracolich. A lich who fails to regularly feed souls to its phylactery fades into a demilich.
Gelidon, the Nightmare in Ivory, is an ancient female white dragon. As an NPC, is played by Matthew Mercer.
.]] Cyclops (, , or ), also known as Kyklops, Clops, or Iflyte, is a recurring creature in the Final Fantasy series. It is a one-eyed giant fights using its immense strength or its gaze.

The Undying is the final boss of Final Fantasy XII. It is the final form that Vayne takes by merging with Venat and assimilating components of the Sky Fortress Bahamut into his body. This form is draconic, as the Sky Fortress's namesake is the recurring dragon summon Bahamut. Entering the Bahamut is the point of no return, and so the player cannot leave without beating the game. However, in The Zodiac Age, the game will auto-save before presenting the cutscene leading into the final battle with The Undying, meaning that the player can retry should they lose, exit for later if desired, or retry the battle after defeating the boss and beating the game, should they so choose. Boziikkodstrun (Dragon Language: Boziik–Kod-Strun, "Boldly–Wield–Storm") is a dragon who survived the Dragon War, and was later used for the creation of the first Daedric Titan. He was researched by Denogorath "the Dread Archivist" by order of the "Greater Titan" Kkrohziz, who wanted the Library of Dusk to contain information on the origins of the Titans. Some time after the Dragon War, Boziikkodstrun, who was considered a "greater dragon," unsuccessfully attempted to fly out of the borders of Mundus. Thurvokun (Dragon Language: ) is an undead Bone Dragon who is found in Fang Lair. He is fought as a boss after being resurrected by Orryn the Black.

The Iron-Swathed Glutton is a unique flesh colossus seen guarding the entrance to the White Gold Tower. He serves as the first boss of the dungeon, and must be defeated in order to enter the tower. The Glutton has red eyes, numerous spikes on his back, and iron embedded into his hands.

Parraptons are giant wasp-like creatures with black multi-faceted eyes and antennae native to Morrowind. They are used by House Dres as mounts and kept in stables and plantations. They are also ridden in bull-riding pens. They are commanded by a somewhat intelligent behemoth Queen parrapton, who considers them her children and hatches them from Sanja. Any who wish to ride a parrapton must be judged worthy by the queen. Riders powder their hands and rub them together to signal to the parraptons when they want to fly or land. The queen is twice the size of an adult, while young parraptons are smaller than adults and cannot be ridden until they are mature. All of them are drones until the queen
Blas Iwan was a young red dragon who sought to transform into a dracolich around 1370 DR.
Arctigis was a white dragon servant of Zhengyi in Vaasa in 1357 DR.
Aglaraerose was an ancient green dragon who lived in a mountain known as the Fang in the Forest in the Earthfast Mountains.
Drazachytus was a fearsome red dragon of ill repute who laired in the Graypeak Mountains of the Savage Frontier some years before the late 14 century DR.
Diogenes was an ancient silver dragon who laired in the Dragonspine Mountains of the Moonsea region around the mid-14 century DR.

Chloracridara was an old female green dragon who lived in the partially standing temple to Corellon Larethian in the ruined Eaerlanni settlement of Mhiilamniir. She had lived there for more than six hundred years by 1372 DR. Rabidly paranoid, Chloracridara claimed the whole city and its environs as her domain, making it too hazardous for elven pilgrims to visit any of the temples.

The Fimmrach are the few Redcaps who specialize in Arts and Realms. Few redcaps have the aptitude, brains, or desire to become fimmrach, but those who do often become fiendishly powerful and are able to exert terror in way unimaginable to their warrior kin. Even the most battle-hardened redcap quails at the thought of a centuries-long fimmrach curse. The most powerful fimmrach, the witch-kings or hag-queens, often rival the sidhe's mightiest sorcerers and rule over vast demesnes of blasted, miasmal land.

Snowskin is one of the sub-types of the Elemental seeming. These changeling are the children of the cold, who can be as powerful as the Arctic ice or as delicate as a snowflake. Theirs is the blessing of The Voice of Ice.

The Zero-Tails can create a multitude of tan coloured arms from its body that chase after the opponent. The arms can also absorb chakra from the opponent. When used by Shinnō, he could also form a wall to shield himself with these arms, enough to block Naruto's Tornado Rasengan.

Mother Gothel, also known as Eloise Gardener, following the Dark Curse, is a character featured in the seventh season of the ABC fantasy-drama series Once Upon a Time. She serves as the main antagonist of the final season. Gothel was a tree nymph who lived in a grove that served as the last refuge of magic in the land. After her fellow sister were massacred by the humans, Gothel in turn eradicated the entire population within the realm, and left for the Magical Forest. Over the thousands of years, Gothel began recruiting witches, to form a coven and destroy humanity for good. She also sought the Guardian, a powerful being of good, whom she initially believed to be Rapunzel. After becoming tr

Vermithrax Pejorative is the main antagonist of the 1981 Disney/Paramount live-action fantasy film Dragonslayer. Vermithrax Pejorative is a 400 year old androgynous dragon that has threatened the post-Roman kingdom of Urland for years. Translated from Latin, her name means "The Wyrm of Thrace that makes things Worse". She is the mother of three dragonets, all of whom were killed by the sorcerer's apprentice Galen Bradwarden, and was herself destroyed by Bradwarden and his master Ulrich.

OmegaKnight is a Digital Lifeform. It is a mysterious with the appearance of a holy knight. It is said to have been developed with reference to the data of a Digimon game. During battle, it deploys the gun muzzle and greatsword that are built into both of its arms. It boasts of overwhelming abilities that wipe out countless enemies in an instant. Attacks *Dominion *Hyper Beam *Beam Sword *
Fyrentennimar, often known as Old Fyren, was a red dragon who had his lair in the Snowflake Mountains of Erlkazar. He was one of the most powerful and famous dragons living in the region.
Aeonus is a dragon of the infinite dragonflight, and the final boss of Opening the Dark Portal in Caverns of Time. He spawns from the 18th and final portal.
The Abyssal Eruptor is a giant infernal that appears at Legion Invasion locations.
Abyssal Doombringers are abyssals that can be seen incinerating the night elven villages near the Shores of the Well in Well of Eternity. A single Abyssal Doombringer is fought.

Desharin (aka Desharin Greensong in guise) was a member of the green dragonflight and a loyal servant of Ysera, who took on his kaldorei guise in order to assist Thrall with his task to soothe a rampant fire elemental in Feralas. He subsequently took Thrall to the Caverns of Time in an effort to discover what befell Nozdormu. However, upon landing in the caverns, Desharin was ambushed and killed by a mysterious infinite dragonflight assassin.

__NOTOC__ Daumyr is a storm drake summoned by lighting Thorim's Beacon at Thorim's Peak in Stormheim. After being killed by Minerva Ravensorrow and the Deathlord of the Knights of the Ebon Blade, Daumyr was raised as an undead drake in their service. From Acherus: The Ebon Hold, she accompanied the Ebon Blade to Vengeance Point on the Broken Shore and rained death upon the demons at the Twisted Grounds and Wrynnfall.
chasing Dafeng.]] Dafeng is the ancient spirit of air on the Wandering Isle. He can be found within the Chamber of Whispers, hiding from Zhao-Ren the Onyx Serpent, which he's afraid of.

Cyanigosa is a powerful blue dragon located in the Violet Hold. She is the final boss encountered in this instance. She was a zealous follower and lieutenant of Malygos, who sent her to Dalaran as the commander of his invading forces. She broke into the Violet Hold and got close to releasing the prisoners, then fought to the death when she was caught. During the Nexus War, she and her Staff of Trickery were perhaps the greatest threat to Dalaran outside of Malygos. Muradin Bronzebeard described her as a cunning one, since she snuck into the prison disguised as an elf mage.

__NOTOC__ Cyclonian is an air elemental summoned by Bath'rah the Windwatcher in the Alterac Mountains. He is referred to as a wind lord. Bath'rah can use Cyclonian's heart to create Whirlwind weapons for warriors.
Crimson Lifebinders are red dragons that storm the Wyrmrest Temple after Morchok is killed. These dragons revive the other fallen dragons in the temple

Chief Telemancer Oculeth is a nightborne mage, portal trainer, and repair vendor located in Suramar. He is a master telemancer, a mage who specializes in portal magic, capable of easily creating large-scale portal networks. Oculeth is intelligent and inquisitive, though somewhat absent-minded at times. He served as one of the founding members of the Nightfallen resistance against Grand Magistrix Elisande. After the nightborne's induction into the Horde, he helped create the Horde's new portal nexuses in Orgrimmar and Dazar'alor.

Bradok was one of the first dragon riders of the Dragonmaw clan during the Second War. He noticed Gul'dan's fleet sailing for the Tomb of Sargeras, and went to discover why he had abandoned his post at Quel'Thalas and set out onto the Great Sea. Gul'dan attacked Bradok as soon as he was in range and killed the dragonrider. His last thought was that at least he'd had a chance to fly. Bradok's companion, Torgus, was not spotted, and managed to report back to Zuluhed the Whacked and inform the rest of the Horde of Gul'dan's betrayal.
__NOTOC__ Bound Vortex is a bound air elemental located at the Twilight Withering in Thousand Needles. It and Bound Fury are two powerful elementals that infuse Animus with a great deal of power.
Blackscale is a black dragon that flies around Raven's Wood in northwestern Blade's Edge Mountains. He appears to be affiliated with the Wyrmcult. He can only be attacked when he lands.
Barastagax the Flamecleaver is an overfiend located in Broken Shore. Through unknown means he was able to harness the powers of the Firelands and was ultimately killed by the Doomstone.

Ban'thalos is a large owl spirit beast who soars Mount Hyjal's skies. Ban'thalos is the first spirit beast to have the look of an owl and is also one of the biggest spirit beasts, mostly due to his large wings. According to Zekhan's report after the Fourth War, the great spirit owl soars above the shrine to the stag loa, Malorne. According to some legends, they were allies long ago, fighting side by side in the war against the demons.

Azure Skywing is a blue drake being tended to by Kalecgos in the Twilight Highlands during Investigating the Highlands. It transported the adventurer to Vermillion Redoubt where it is shot. Other skywings appear flying near the top of the Nexus in Borean Tundra during A Bolt from the Blue.

Atulhet was a tol'vir buried within the Tombs of the Precursors in Uldum. He was a prophet who held off a troves of enemies by channeling the power of the sun. He also created The Cypher of Keset and hid it in Keset Pass.
Arikara is a red wind serpent who dwelled in Thousand Needles. The tauren believe Arikara to be a spirit of vengeance.

Arcaisme is a mage. While many mages are proficient at the creation of a firebolt, he is one of the few who have mastered fire magic to the point where he could continue to charge energy into a spell. He once concentrated several moments on casting pyroblast during a battle. Once he had charged the spell, he released it causing massive fire damage to his enemy.

The Apexis were an ancient and now-extinct arakkoan civilization that attained a height of power during the Age of Order before abruptly vanishing. They were a glorious empire of the sun that ruled vast territories alongside the ogre empire centuries ago. The Apexis had their own language. They were winged, and unlike the Adherents of Rukhmar that would emerge much later, the Apexis arakkoa did not partake in the barbaric practice of throwing outcasts and heretics into the Sethekk Hollow in order to afflict them with the curse of Sethe. The Apexis were led by two factions: the Anhar, wielders of the Light, and the Skalax, wielders of the Void and arcane. They shared equal prestige and influe

Aloskixxa is a giant boneguard located in the northeastern end of the Bleak Redoubt in Maldraxxus during the bombing run in Enemy at the Door. They can be damaged by Ragewing's abilities but do not grant any quest progress if killed.

__NOTOC__ Alani is a large red cloud serpent flying high above the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. The legend of its/her creation is told by Loh-Ki . Alani is present during the Assaults in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

is an animated cartoon character in the Warner Bros. Looney Tunes and Merrie Melodies series of cartoons. He is portrayed as "The Fastest Mouse in all Mexico" with his major traits being the ability to run extremely fast, being quick-witted and heroic while speaking with an exaggerated Mexican accent. He usually wears a yellow sombrero, white shirt and trousers (which was a common traditional outfit worn by men and boys of rural Mexican villages), and a red kerchief, similar to that of some traditional Mexican attires. To date, there have been 46 theatrical shorts made either starring or featuring the character. He makes a cameo appearance in the finale sequence of Who Framed Roger Rabbit.

Tempestoro is a violent and horribly destructive Bane that manifests in low Gauntlet areas or places where it has been brought through to unleash its chaos.

Spurious Stature is the blessing of the Gargantuans. The changelings blessed with it can once a day grow to colossal size. The player spends a point of Glamour, and adds the changeling's Wyrd score to her size for the rest of the scene. This supplies temporary Health dots (see the World of Darkness Rulebook, p. 175). Returning to normal size is painful, as if the changeling's skin is unable to contain the character's stature, and when she regains her normal height, the character takes one point of lethal damage.

The corrupted worm is a creature/animal that is native to Cybertron's depths that became corrupted by Dark Energon and was subsequently used by the Decepticons as a guard dog for the Core. The worm serves as the boss of the Autobot level, To The Core. As the Autobots move to the core of Cybertron, they are attacked several times by a corrupted space worm. The worm hinders the Autobots on their mission to reach the Core and attacks them. When the Autobots finally reach the core, the worm shows up again and draws energy from the core. It uses this additional energy as well as it's large arsenal of weaponry to stop them. The battle ends with the worm destroyed. The worm has two eyes and a mouth

Yamath, the Lord of the Flames (: The Wizard of Lemuria, Lin Carter; "The Pillars of Melkarth", Richard Tierney), is a deity worshipped in ancient Lemuria in Patanga, City of the Flame, one of the three primal lords of Lemuria and an aspect of the Triple God of Chaos.

The SD-90 "Orion" is a tier 5 Drone unit used by Skynet's surveillance and recon air patrol units to scan areas of any remaining humans, in continuing its goal of achieving extinction of humanity. It has advanced scanning systems which are capable of scanning hidden bunkers and other underground structures inhabited by humans.

The Mecha Unit Skullder 001, also known as the Skullder Unit 001 or Skullder Unit 01, is a model of goliath with superior combat power created in a secret Confederate Remnant research facility sometime after the fall of the Confederacy. The Kimeran Pirates stole a file detailing the model from the facility. One Skullder Unit 001 appeared on Braxis during the Resurrection incident. The pilot turned against Infested Stukov and attempted to attack its forces by itself. Jim Raynor recruited him in the attack. Dragons (or wyrms) were very powerful and magical creatures. There were several types of dragons, the most common of which were chromatic and metallic, which were evil and good respectively. They were an ancient race. Few species that still exist can claim longer lineage. Dragons were the bane of the creator races of Toril; their line was so old, they had their own realm during the first recorded exploits of the elves. In recent times, the dragons of Toril were nearly all recluses or at the very least secretive as to their true nature, living among other species in polymorphed form.

Dhaerhaera Nanatar was a female human wizard and adventuress who made her home in Tantras in the Vast around 1358 DR. She was one of the more notable mages of the city at the time. In the late 1350s DR, Dhaerhaera captured a griffon and successfully tamed it and taught it to carry her as a rider. Riding her griffon, she regularly flew around the Vast looking for adventure. After the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR, her project was exploring the old mountain tombs and strongholds of elves and humans, dating back to the time when dwarves ruled the Vast. She sought lost magic, and had some success in this.
Dargentum the Darksteel Drake was a silver great wyrm who resided in the abandoned realm of Clan Ironstar inside Firstpeak, above the River Surbrin.

Cenarius (pronounced sənɑ:riəs, like "sin-AH-ree-uhs"), Lord of the Forest and patron of many druids, is one of the most powerful and influential demigods of Azeroth. Worshipped by the night elves since their early history, the Son of Malorne taught the elves to be druids and embrace nature, as opposed to the arcane-inclined Highborne and the religiously-inclined Sisterhood of Elune. He served as a commander of the forces of Kalimdor in the War of the Ancients after the death of his father. He continued serving as a teacher and protector of the elves and their forests for 10,000 years until he was killed by the demonically corrupted orcs led by Grom Hellscream. Kukulkan, also written K'uk'ulkan, is the feathered serpent creator god of ancient Maya mythology. He is believed to embody the sky, wind and rain and provides the energy to sustain life. The name Kukulkan is formed from the Mayan language words feathered (k'uk'ul) and serpent (kan). In the Cthulhu Mythos, Kukulkan is considered to be another name for Yig.

Upon entering this form, Weeping Reclusa bats away Bowser and his minions, before unleashing a wave of Glohm that knocks out Mario, Luigi and Snoutlet. Connie uses the power of bonds to revive the bros, and the battle with the tree begins.

Fyrillius was a red dragon in the service of Orcus in the Abyss in 1357 DR.
Acidous is a fire spider and one of Zonya the Sadist's pets in Stonetalon Mountains.
Dread Captain "Moldy" Nadeux was the captain of The Blightbringer, which brought Horde players to battle in the Strand of the Ancients. She couldn't be killed.

He is unleashed upon the Frostwolf clan as they invade the citadel, hurling flaming boulders down on them as they attempt to reach the upper level of the keep and then confronting them personally. After Gorr'thog's defeat, his corpse can be found leaned against a wall in his lair, being fed to some hungry frost wolves, and notes that the adventurers impressed him by defeating the ogron.
Donovan is a gryphon located around Stormheim along his owner, Lorna Crowley. He is the flight master at Skyfire Triage Camp and Lorna's Watch.

Divo Songscale is a ghostly blue dragonspawn that appears atop the ruined tower after interacting with Ancient Remains in Camp Antonidas in the Azure Span.
Depleted War Golem is an iron golem summoned by Golem Control Unit (depleted) in Grizzly Hills.
Defias Magicians are human mages of the Defias Brotherhood that could be found in the original Deadmines. They could summon Living Flames.
Curigosa was a blue dragon who was killed by Neltharion's betrayal during the War of the Ancients. Her name is on a Faded Gravestone at the Veiled Ossuary.
Crystal Wyrms are blue dragons patrolling over the Azure Front in Crystalsong Forest. They circle the giant crystallized tree.

Crestfall Rise is a subzone of Ashran, the physical tower found in the Archmage Overwatch zone. The tower appears to be named for its inhabitant the Alliance Tower Guardian Rylai Crestfall, who can be found here surveying the battle below, and smiting any enemies within range with her frost and ice magic. The tower itself is cloaked in a constant snowstorm, no doubt thanks to the mage's magics.

Couatl are large flying beasts used by the naga for aerial support. They possess two crests running from their head to their lower back, and wings, which they can also use as fins to swim. Naga train them in Shrines of Azshara. Morgala Darksquall summoned an immense couatl to attack the ship Wavecutter. She referred to it as a "dark denizen of the deep", and it was able to spit acidic venom.

Coridormi is an elite bronze dragon that appears in the Wizard's Sanctum of the Mage Quarter of Stormwind City. During the Warcraft's Anniversary, she is found in the Caverns of Time where she urges adventurers to have a swing at the Displaced Scarab Gong.
The Colossal Water Cobra is a huge serpent that spawns atop the Verdant Plateau in Vol'dun after the player moves the Loose Boulder during The Source of the Problem.

Claximus is a makrura that controls the Winterfin murlocs in the Winterfin Caverns within the Borean Tundra. He drew members of the tribe in by kidnapping their tadpoles, and then used magic that seeped in from Coldarra, to seize control of their minds. He was slain by adventurers sent by King Mrgl-Mrgl, who disguised themselves as murlocs ready to surrender, then ended him.

The Chosen Ascendant is a tol'vir located in the Chamber of the Stars in Uldum during the Assault in Uldum. He is suspended high in the air, the focus of a ritual performed by four Suntouched Ritualists. Once they are defeated, he will die as the energies of the ritual runs amok.

A chimaera (sometimes spelled chimera - pronounced "kai-mare-ah" in both cases) is a large, two-headed flying creature resembling a mix between a dragon and a wyvern. There are two types of creatures called chimaera in the Warcraft universe, one located in Azeroth and the other in Outland. Outland chimera are mutated rylaks.

Silvery, translucent skin stretches tight over its form, accentuating its skeletal frame. She retained all of her intelligence and memories before her transformation into undead, and she also has an intimate connection with the minds and senses of all the undead under her command. She may know things that her undead minions have discovered, even if the minion was not intelligent to make sense of its findings.
